summary: No new receipt this turn; I filled the one piece of required bookkeeping that was still empty — recorded knowledge uses. The method asks for actual uses by exact revision and relied-on assertion, and the record had none, which under-reported the dependencies between the findings and the durable entries. Six uses are now recorded and each names the assertion it relies on: the parent interpretation uses the Fact that a configuration entry inside the replayed committed prefix is not restored, the Behavior that a stale membership drives admission, next-membership derivation, commitment-on-append, election quorum, lease and leadership confirmation, and the repair Fact; the resurrect and forgotten-voter investigations each use the Behavior for why their stale-membership quorum counted; and the operator-recovery investigation uses the repair Fact to place RecoverCluster among the working paths and live bootstrap outside them. All entries are pointed at their current revisions, the submission validates, and no execution is requested.
